repaired.name: Scenario
repaired.script:
t1 = (#Study_Temp).temperatureSensor_temperature
delay(20 MIN)
t2 = (#Study_Temp).temperatureSensor_temperature
diff = t2 - t1
if (diff >= 3) {
    (#Study_AC).airConditioner_setAirConditionerMode("cool")
}

diagnosis.summary: The candidate computes an absolute difference (lines 4-7) before checking the condition, whereas the IR requires the exact signed difference ($t2 - $t1). Evidence F2 shows the JoI emitted an action when the IR did not, because a temperature drop (t2 < t1) resulted in a large positive `diff` after the absolute-value correction, falsely satisfying `diff >= 3`. The IR only triggers when the temperature rises by at least 3 units.
diagnosis.change_summary: Removed the absolute-value correction logic. Restored the direct signed subtraction ($t2 - $t1) to match the IR's condition. This ensures the action only fires when t2 is at least 3 units greater than t1, preventing false positives on temperature drops.
